Game Overview

Eco Terra Idle puts players into a strategy experience centered on embark on a captivating journey as the guardian of a polluted planet, transforming trash into valuable resources. Explore stunning landscapes, upgrade your base, and harness the power of unique robots. Clean waterways and purify air to restore the planet's beauty and discover cutting-edge eco-friendly technologies.
